question: In 1856, Governor-General ______ decided that Bahadur Shah Zafar would be the last Mughal king and after his death none of his descendants would be recognised as kings - they would just be called princes.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Canning.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bahadur Shah Zafar** would be the** final Mughal king,** and after his death, none of his** progeny would be acknowledged as kings**, according to a decision made by **Governor-General Canning in 1856.**
 
• Only** princes **would be used to describe his** offspring.**
 
• In **1849, Governor-General Dalhousie** made the announcement that following** Zafar's passing**, his family would be relocated from the **Red Fort** and given a new home to live in **Delhi.**
 
• Around this period, the name of the **Mughal King** was also erased off the **coinage.**
 
• **Lord Canning:**
 
 
• During the **1857 Indian Rebellion**, British statesman **Charles Canning **served as **Governor-General of India.**
 
• After the **East India Company's dominance** was transferred to **Queen Victoria's Crown** in **1858, **he served as **India's first Viceroy.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lord Cornwallis:**

 
 
• ​Lord Cornwallis was a **British Army general and official.**
 
• He supported the **Cornwallis Code and the Permanent Settlement** in India.
 
 
 
• **Lord Hastings:**
 
 
• Warren Hastings was a **British colonial administrator.**
 
• He served as the** first Governor of the Presidency of Fort William.**
 
• In the** years 1772–1785**, he served as **Bengal's first governor-general.**
 
• The British Empire in India is said to have been founded by **him and Robert Clive.**
 
 
 
• **Lord Munro:**
 
 
• Sir Thomas Munro was a** statesman **and **officer in the East India Company Army.**
 
• He served as the **Madras Presidency's governor.**
